Hon'ble Piyush Agrawal,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned AGA for the State.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashing the entire proceeding of Criminal Case No. 4035 of 2016 arising out of case crime no. 535 of 2015 under section 498A, 323,
506 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act as well a charge sheet dated 19.7.2016 P.S.Sipari Bazar, District Jhansi.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the FIR filed by the informant refers to the incident which has been alleged to be occurred on 14.2.2015 at 3.00 P.M. thereafter another incident has been referred which has been alleged to be occurred on 13.7.2015.

He further submits that the allegation made in the FIR that the applicant along with his parents visited the house of the Pawan Sharma vs State Of U.P. And Another on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85436527/
1 informant and demanded specific dowry is not correct.

sentences.text: He further submits that incident as alleged is false as on the said date the applicant was discharging his duties in Railway department, a certificate in respect thereof has been issued by the department, which has been brought on record as Annexure 4 wherein it has been referred that the applicant was discharging his duties on the date of occurrence.

He further submits that the Investigating Officer has added section 323 IPC in the FIR without any basis at his own for which neither he has any authority nor any thing has been brought on record in support thereof.

He further submits that since the applicant was on duty on the date of alleged occurrence and a certificate to that effect has been issued by his Department the entire proceedings in the aforesaid criminal case deserves to be quashed.

Per contra, learned AGA submits that it is not a fit case to be interfered with at this stage as the FIR contains the allegation against the applicant and findings have been recorded by the Investigating Officer against him.
He prays for dismissal of the application.

After hearing the learned counsel for the parties and perusing the records it has been mentioned that the applicant was discharging his duties on the date of occurrence and a certificate issued by his Department to that effect has been annexed as Annexure 4 to the application.
The certificate only refers that the applicant was present in the office on the basis of the attendance register.
He was discharging his duties at Jhansi and the distance from the place of occurrence is about 75 kms which can be travelled within one and a half hours.
Hence taking shelter of the certificate that he was not present on the date and place of occurrence cannot be sustained.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant may be directed to move a discharge application before the court below .
In view of the order proposed to be passed no notice is required to be issued to the opposite party no.2.
The present application is disposed of with the direction to the applicant to move a discharge application before the court below with all materials to show his bona fide within ten days from today.
In case such an application is moved the concerned court shall make all endeavour to decide the same in accordance with law within a period of next two months.

Order Date :- 20.7.2023 samz  Pawan Sharma vs State Of U.P. And Another on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85436527/
